title: hieracium bifidum subsp. macrolobum
intro: Hieracium bifidum subsp. macrolobum, commonly known as Hawkweed, is a plant species belonging to the dandelion-like plants in the sunflower family. The health benefits of Hawkweed include its potential use in treating fever, inflammation, and digestive issues, with its leaves and stems being used in traditional medicine. Therapeutically, Hawkweed is used as an anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and antiseptic agent, with its bioactive constituents including sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties. However, more research is needed to fully understand the plant's effects on human health and its potential applications.
